narrative_summary:
Okay, here's a director-level summary of the "QR Punch Tracker" system architecture, focusing on its resilience and ability to handle data for an Excel spreadsheet:

**To my mind you need a spreadsheet that does the following:**

*   **QR Code Scanning:** Use your phone to scan the QR code and the spreadsheet will automatically record the time.
*   **Employee Punch Tracking:** The system must be able to accurately record each time an employee punches in or out.
*   **Data Export:** Export the recorded punches as an excel file

***

**Director-Level Summary: QR Punch Tracker System**

Imagine our "QR Punch Tracker" as a reliable time clock that uses QR codes instead of physical cards. Here's what you need to know:

*   **Core Function:** Employees use their smartphones to scan a QR code when they arrive (punch in) and when they leave (punch out). This scan instantly records the time and the employee's ID. The system must be able to automatically save the new record into a formatted table.
*   **Data Handling and Excel Integration:** The system is designed to be exported as an excel file to easily store historical punch data.
*   **Resilience (25.03):**  We've built in layers of protection to keep the system running smoothly, even if there are temporary network issues or if one part of the system fails.  This is what Resilience 25.03 means.
*   **Simple Reporting:** At any time, you can export the data from the database to excel.

**In short:**  This system provides a reliable and easy-to-use way to track employee time using QR codes, focusing on easy integration with excel files.

kpis.name: Clock-in Accuracy
kpis.description: Percentage of punches recorded within a defined threshold (e.g., +/- 5 minutes) of scheduled start time.

kpis.name: Clock-out Accuracy
kpis.description: Percentage of punches recorded within a defined threshold (e.g., +/- 5 minutes) of scheduled end time.

kpis.name: Total Attendance Hours
kpis.description: Sum of all clocked-in hours for all employees during a week.

kpis.name: Unexcused Absence Rate
kpis.description: Percentage of scheduled work time missed without approved leave.

kpis.name: Overtime Hours
kpis.description: Number of overtime hours clocked by employees.

kpis.name: Late Punches
kpis.description: Count of punches recorded after the scheduled start time per pay period across all employees.

reasons: Minimalist direct-path architecture chosen for cost-optimized initial deployment.

roadmap.title: QR Code Generation & Data Capture Setup
roadmap.desc: Select a QR code generator (free online tools or library) to create unique QR codes for each employee.  Implement a mobile-friendly web form or mobile app (consider using low-code platforms like AppSheet or Power Apps for speed) that allows employees to scan the QR code and submit punch-in/punch-out data (timestamp and employee ID).  Optionally, integrate a simple time clock API for enhanced accuracy.  Deploy this application to a basic web server or cloud platform.

roadmap.title: Data Storage & Transformation
roadmap.desc: Configure a mechanism to receive the data from the web form/app. The simplest approach is to directly append the data to a CSV file stored in a cloud storage solution like AWS S3, Azure Blob Storage, or Google Cloud Storage. Alternatively, a lightweight database (e.g., SQLite, Google Sheets) can serve as an intermediary.  Schedule a regular process (e.g., cron job, serverless function) to transform this data into a format suitable for import into Excel. This may involve cleaning, formatting timestamps, and handling missing values.

roadmap.title: Excel Integration & Reporting
roadmap.desc: Implement a process to import the transformed data into the Excel spreadsheet. This can be done manually (download the CSV and import), or automated using VBA scripting within Excel or a scripting language (Python, PowerShell) to access the cloud storage and import the data.  Design the Excel spreadsheet with appropriate columns (Employee ID, Date, Punch-In Time, Punch-Out Time) and format the data. Create basic summary reports (e.g., daily/weekly employee hours) using Excel formulas or pivot tables.

roadmap.title: Testing & Deployment
roadmap.desc: Thoroughly test the entire system end-to-end, from QR code scanning to Excel reporting.  Test with multiple employees and scenarios (e.g., multiple punches per day, missing punch-out).  Train employees on how to use the QR code system. Deploy the web form/app to a production environment. Monitor the system for errors and data integrity issues.  Implement a backup and recovery plan for the CSV/database and Excel spreadsheet.
